question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"diversity".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• **"Diversity" **means a range of different things or people.
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of having a variety of things.
 
 
• **Example: **The company prides itself on its diversity and inclusivity policies.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"assortment", **also means a range of different things or people, but it is less commonly used than **"diversity".**
 
• Option 2, **"variability", **refers to the degree to which something varies or changes, and does not fit in the context of having a range of different things.
 
• Option 3, **"multitude", **refers to a large number of things or people, but does not necessarily imply diversity.
